subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar add a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings destination, or integrate this aggregation into the existing cross-provider Overview surface?
rationale: The implementation and proof are adequate, but VISION.md reserves new feature surfaces for maintainer sign-off and current main already has an adjacent Overview concept.

options.title: Integrate With Overview
options.body: Preserve the aggregation model but move or expose it through the established cross-provider Overview to avoid parallel summary destinations.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Pane
options.body: Approve Usage & Spend as a permanent top-level Settings destination and accept its separate navigation and maintenance surface.

options.title: Decline New Surface
options.body: Do not add the dashboard and retain current provider-specific charts plus the existing Overview.

recommendation.title: Integrate With Overview
recommendation.body: Preserve the aggregation model but move or expose it through the established cross-provider Overview to avoid parallel summary destinations.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the repository policy governing sign-off for new features and product-surface complexity.
